v2.0.training_data: 160 train contexts only (CC BY 4.0 columns); no test/validation labels used for fitting; alpha selected on validation only

v2.1.split: v2.1 frozen 30 train / 20 validation / 200 test contexts (data/mame_fixed_context_splits_v21.json)
v2.1.training_data: 30 v2.1 train contexts only (CC BY 4.0 columns); no test/validation labels used for fitting; alpha selected on v2.1 validation only
v2.1.validation_construction: both pair modes per validation context (20 contexts x 2 modes = 40 cases)
v2.1.test_construction: 1 case per test context, identical construction to canon build_cases (Random(SEED) sample order, mode by index parity)
v2.1.comparability: v2.1 numbers are a NEW version and are NOT comparable to v2.0/v1 numbers (different split, train size and case set); v1 remains frozen

v2.2.split: v2.1 frozen 30 train / 20 validation / 200 test contexts (data/mame_fixed_context_splits_v21.json), UNMODIFIED from v2.1
v2.2.training_data: 30 v2.1 train contexts only (CC BY 4.0 columns); no test/validation labels used for fitting; alpha selected on v2.1 validation only
v2.2.validation_construction: both pair modes per validation context (20 contexts x 2 modes = 40 cases), identical to v2.1
v2.2.test_construction: BOTH pair modes per test context (200 contexts x 2 modes = 400 cases) via the identical build_cases_both_modes used for the v2.1 validation pool; cases are two observations of 200 contexts, not 400 independent cases
v2.2.comparability: v2.2 numbers are a NEW version and are NOT same-condition comparisons with v2.0/v2.1 numbers (test construction differs); within v2.2 all arms face identical cases and scoring
v2.2.gate_definition: an arm beats prior iff strict_accuracy is strictly greater than prior's AND mean_regret is <= prior's (pre-registration section 4)

v1-actions-24.model_label: Be.FM 1.5-4B (LoRA on Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Q4_K_M GGUF base)

scores.ground_truth: Winner determined by difference of two independently aggregated 5-human binary-funny fractions. NOT a 5-rater pairwise head-to-head comparison.

v1-actions-24.holdout: frozen prior P09-5 context-disjoint 160 train/40 valid/50 test; identical 24 selected heldout contexts, seed 20261107, identical prompts and scoring as BFM-02
v1-actions-24.limitation: 24 context-level pilot; text-only (no manga images or dialogue); the Japanese instruction text is identical for every model, wrapped in each model family's native chat template (prompt_format field); the BFM-02 Qwen runs used the same text with ChatML

definition.prior_marginal_full: Grouped empirical mode (classification) or mean (numeric) on the official test split, including the scored item. Reproduces Muse full-split surv_resp_pred Acc 0.3944.
definition.prior_loo: Same grouped statistic with the scored item held out.
definition.prior_constant_mean: For first-round game_behavior: official protocol of N identical draws of the population mean (point mass).
definition.prior_constant_mode: Same protocol with the population mode.
definition.human_human_split_half: Not a model. Split human actions (50/150 when n=200) and measure W; seed 20261111, 200 repeats, to sit next to Muse's published human baseline.
